subject: Final-mile stall triage and owner nexus
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@meridianthera.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@meridianthera.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: acceptance window shift for Meridian pilot

Hi Jasmine,

Quick heads up — procurement has flagged some legal clarifications that will hold up our internal sign-off by ~10 business days. That pushes the acceptance tests we were planning for the week of May 24th.

We can still run the pilot, but the evaluation window will need to move out by two weeks. This unfortunately strains our internal go/no-go calendar with regulatory sign-offs. Can Redwood accommodate a short extension to the MAP? If there's an alternative that avoids moving the acceptance window (e.g., a limited-functionality canary or staging-only run) that might also work for us.

Appreciate any remediation ideas — we want to keep momentum but need the legal team to finish their review.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Program Manager, Meridian Therapeutics
liam.oconnor@meridianthera.com

[Attachment: internal_legal_issue_summary.pdf (referenced)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@meridianthera.com>
Cc: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@meridianthera.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: acceptance window shift for Meridian pilot

Liam — thanks for the heads up and for being candid about the procurement timing. We can absolutely work options here; priority is keeping go-live risk low while preserving the quality checks you need.

Options we recommend (quick summary):
- Option A — Short extension: move acceptance window +14 days; Redwood provides a one-week canary (limited traffic) to validate integration before full acceptance.
- Option B — No-window-shift: run a staging-only canary now (non-production) to keep close confidence, with formal acceptance after legal sign-off.
- Option C — Hybrid: 7-day extension + temporary dedicated capacity for the pilot to reduce sequence risk and keep your teams aligned.

I attached an updated MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) and a draft SOW (SOW_draft_v2.pdf) that reflect Option C as our recommended path. If it helps, Marissa and I can jump on a 30-minute exec sync to sign off on credits/acceptance gates.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Meridian to confirm preferred option by EOD Thursday (so we can lock resource scheduling).
2) If extension is required, we will issue a short risk log and adjust the MAP milestones; tentative credit proposal (see internal note) — to be approved by Marissa.
3) Karthik to scope minimal canary run and list expected telemetry.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com]

[Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet); SOW_draft_v2.pdf (document)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Meridian MAP ask — risk log & quick approval needed

Team — looping you in on Meridian's procurement delay. Summary below; asking for quick decisions by EOD so we don't lose the reserved capacity window.

What happened:
- Legal flagged a couple of contract clauses tied to data retention and audit logs; procurement paused sign-off (10 business days).
- Customer asked for a two-week push of the acceptance window.

Immediate risks:
- Resource slot exposure: our Dedicated pool is heavily booked the weeks after May 24. If we don't confirm, we'll need to shift them and may lose the current SLA promise.
- Revenue timing: potential deferred recognition if acceptance slips > 30 days.
- Customer sentiment: keep them engaged and avoid momentum loss.

Proposed mitigation (recommended):
1) Approve Option C from my note (7-day extension + temporary dedicated trial) — provides runway for legal while keeping momentum.
2) Offer a one-time 5% credit on first-month billing as a commercial concession tied to the extension.
3) Karthik: outline a 72-hr telemetry plan for the canary (latency, error rates, KV cache warmup).
4) Camila: hold a 1-hour onboarding acceleration slot during the canary to reduce operational handoffs.

If we approve items 1–3 now I will send Meridian an updated MAP + SOW and propose a Friday exec sync (30 min) with Liam and Elena.

Please reply-all with Approve / Reject / Suggest edits.

—Jasmine

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Meridian MAP ask — risk log & quick approval needed

Jasmine — thanks for the clear breakdown. Approve the proposed mitigation with two adjustments:

1) Instead of a 5% billing credit, authorize a one-time service credit equal to 5% of the first invoice but require a signed amendment to the MAP that pins the new acceptance milestone (protects finance).
2) Add a rollback trigger in the MAP: if canary telemetry shows >1.5% error delta or sustained latency increase >30% for 2 consecutive hours, we automatically pause full traffic. This reduces operational exposure.

Karthik — please prioritize the 72-hr telemetry checklist and include the exact alerting thresholds. Camila — reserve the onboarding accelerator slot (Wed next week) and prepare a one-pager for the Meridian ops team.

Jasmine — go ahead and send the updated MAP + SOW to Liam; copy me on the exec sync invite. I can be on the call if Meridian wants to expedite approval.

Marissa Cole
Director, Account Strategy, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

[Attachment referenced: internal_credit_calc.xlsx (internal use)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@meridianthera.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@meridianthera.com>, procurement@meridianthera.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: acceptance window shift for Meridian pilot

Jasmine / Marissa — thanks for the rapid response and for laying out options. Meridian will accept the hybrid path (7-day extension + temporary dedicated trial) and agrees to the service credit approach with the MAP amendment and rollback trigger.

Next steps from our side:
- Procurement will sign the MAP amendment (procurement@meridianthera.com) by close of day Thursday.
- Elena will coordinate the regulatory checklist and canary acceptance criteria with Karthik.
- Please send the updated MAP + SOW and a calendar invite for the Friday exec sync at 11:00 PT.

Appreciate the flexibility — this preserves our go-to-market cadence while we finish internal review.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Program Manager, Meridian Therapeutics
liam.oconnor@meridianthera.com
